items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, I played with Zoot and Jimmy Rowles and I can’t remember who played drums, we worked at The Haig

ctx.x: This was in the middle of the war.

The war, yeah, the war, all the good musicians were overseas, so a lot of us who, oh God that whole gang I came out with, like Al Cohn, Stan Getz, they were good, all of us, Zoot Sims, we were alright, you know we were pretty damn good for our age.
And you were all the same age.
